summary: Biohaven Ltd. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing a U.S. FDA partial clinical hold letter dated September 4, 2026 affecting the BHV-7000 epilepsy program. The hold pauses only new patient enrollment pending additional nonclinical data on a specific drug metabolite; dosing continues for more than 600 already-randomized patients across the program. BHV7000-303 is fully enrolled and randomized, with topline data still expected in the second half of 2026; BHV7000-302 faces enrollment delays. No deal, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is stated; this is a regulatory/clinical update, not a special situation. Watch resolution timing and any downstream timeline impact.
